text: Jee haan 🙂 It could be because of I (Iohannes) V(ermeer)…But I like to think because 4 (IV) in Dutch/German is pronounced “fear” like Vermeer’s “fer-meeyer” His “girl with the pearl earring” is possibly the most popular… but I love this one so much. He does this trick with light that I love: recreates a regular domestic atmosphere of intense quiet and frozen time. But somehow often includes a subtle implication of motion (like the pouring milk here)…
